acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Arachnids family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Weaver, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Eight-Eye Pattern Specialist (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: First spider-centaur silhouette with a humanoid torso on the spider body, eight bright eyes, two hands, and silk-wrapped blades.

Signature mechanic: Handed Loom: the Weaver's humanoid hands cross two silk lines around silk-wrapped blades. Four pairs among eight bright eyes follow four resulting quadrants; the quadrant watched by mismatched eye colors remains safe while the other three tighten.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot the encounter by using the first humanoid torso and hands to reweave two existing lines into a temporary safe-and-danger pattern.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T2 remain spiders with no humanoid torso and gain mineral cuffs only at existing leg, fang, abdomen, and spinneret structures; T3–T5 retain the existing humanoid torso with fitted stone-silk armor and hand-mounted crystal tensioners.
Load paths gain stratified chitin plates, grit-braided silk, crystal joint wedges, stone web anchors, and pale fractures at whichever leg or throne support carries the active lattice.
counterplay: Enter the mismatched-eye quadrant and cut the lower hand's thread or strike the exposed torso waist while the three other lines pull taut. Affinity signal: A crystal wedge locks the loaded leg and the corresponding web anchor turns chalk-white; break either point to collapse that span.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only brown chitin without strata, anchors, and changed load paths
Glow-only earth treatment without mineral structure and fractures
Invented humanoid torso or hands on T1–T2 for stone equipment
Rock bulk that hides spider joints, abdomen, or web topology
identityInvariants: A bulbous abdomen, eight jointed legs arching around the body, clustered eyes, fangs, and spinnerets remain legible; a humanoid torso is added only from T3 onward.
Black, charcoal, deep violet, blood-red markings, pale silk white, and green, red, or amber eye accents form the source palette.
Chitin, coarse bristle, silk, bone, amber, venom sheen, and eye settings remain physically distinct family materials.
Web decorations, silk robes, egg sacs, wrapped prey, jeweled eye settings, and layered drapery communicate escalation.
Leg load, spinneret direction, fang posture, silk tension, and eye cluster alignment preserve readable attack and recovery states.
telegraph: The first humanoid torso rises, both wrapped blades cross, two spinneret lines enter the hands, and eight eyes separate into four readable pairs.
